name: Mystic Maroon
lede: Mystic Maroon pairs the vague modifier "mystic" with [[maroon]], though the result is a strong purplish red that sits well outside maroon's own brownish territory.

sections.title: A modifier that overshoots its parent
sections.body:
Our library traces this name only to a Wikipedia color list, with no first-recorded date given [1]. It modifies [[maroon]] with "mystic," but the resulting swatch, a strong purplish red, sits closer to magenta than to maroon's own brownish red [1]. The ISCC-NBS dictionary's nearest block is "strong purplish red," 4.1 units from that block's centre [1].

Its nearest named neighbor is [[magenta-haze|Magenta Haze]], 2.8 units away and duller [2]. [[maximum-red-purple|Maximum Red Purple]] sits 3.1 units out, read as almost the same color, and [[irresistible|Irresistible]] 4.6 units out, redder [2]. Measured in LCH it reads lightness 45, chroma 50, hue 350 degrees [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Our archive finds this exact color in only 3 of 23,781 paintings (1 by the within-painting lens), rarer than 88 percent of the named colors, as photographed [3]. The sample is too thin here to say more about painters or centuries [3].
